kundli.emptyProfile: Add your birth details to see your Kundli.
kundli.computeError: Could not compute the chart. Please check your birth details.
kundli.noTimeNote: No birth time set — the Ascendant (Lagna) and houses need an exact time. Planet signs and the Dasha use noon as an estimate. Add your birth time in Profile for a precise chart.
kundli.legend: ↺ = retrograde · Houses are whole-sign from the Lagna
kundli.cycleLegend: The 120-year Vimshottari cycle, seeded by your Janma Nakshatra ({name}).
kundli.disclaimer: Sidereal (Lahiri ayanamsa {ayanamsa}°). For guidance and self-reflection, not a substitute for professional advice.
dasha.emptyBody: Vimshottari Dasha is calculated from your natal Moon. Add your date and place of birth to see your current periods.
dasha.intro: Your running Vimshottari period, nested from the major cycle down to the current sub-sub-period.
dasha.disclaimer: Vimshottari Dasha (120-year cycle) from your natal Moon nakshatra, sidereal (Lahiri). If no birth time is set, noon is used — sub-period dates can shift. Offered for guidance and reflection.
sadesati.emptyBody: Sade Sati is measured from your natal Moon sign. Add your date and place of birth to see your current Saturn phase.
sadesati.disclaimer: Phase dates are approximate — Saturn's retrograde motion shifts exact sign-change timing by weeks. Computed with the sidereal (Lahiri) system, from your natal Moon sign. Offered for guidance and reflection, not prediction.
tarot.dailySub: A single card to reflect on today — the same for you all day.

tarot.disclaimer: Tarot is offered for reflection and self-insight, drawn from the {count}-card Rider–Waite–Smith tradition. It is not a substitute for professional advice.

match.errCoordsB: We couldn't find coordinates for "{place}". Try a nearby major city.

match.shareMessage:
Our Astropanth compatibility ✨ {a} & {b}: {total}/36 ({band})

Check yours free: https://www.astropanth.com
match.lowConfidenceNote: Add birth times for the most precise result. The Moon can change nakshatra within a single day, so a missing time lowers confidence.
match.disclaimer: Guna Milan is one traditional factor in compatibility, not a verdict — consider a full reading.
match.bandExcellent: A strong traditional match across most kootas.
match.bandGood: A favourable match by the classical count.
match.bandAverage: A moderate match — some kootas align, others less so.
match.bandNotRecommended: Few kootas align by the classical count.
